bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Tuesday) the track is rated a soft 5 but with fine weather forecast an upgrade is expected. PEARL DU JOUR worked home okay over 1400m at Dalby second up. She can settle closer to the speed from the kind draw up in trip here and is worth keeping safe this time. CHECK ONE TWO is racking up the convictions but is seldom far away and can get back into minors at least. TIGER ROCKET made good ground from the back over 1300m last time and the rise to 1560m looks suitable on that. STREAMELOT was never likely last start but had been thereabouts prior.

raceTips.comment: PEARL DU JOUR got well back and worked home nicely last start at Dalby. At peak fitness, the rise in trip looks ideal and the winkers go on. GOTCHA MOMENT strips fitter for the two runs back and will appreciate dropping back to maiden grade. CHECK ONE TWO steps out for the new yard. She’s suited at this journey but with five weeks between runs, fitness is the query. TIGER ROCKET settled at the tail and made good ground late last start over 1400m. The rise in trip will suit.

bestBets.overview: Six-year-old debutante HOOROO draws kindly and placed in a recent Rockhampton trial. Connections have been patient and he must be kept safe. CHEERS HONEY also draws well for her first attempt and was placed in a recent trial at this track. PROVISEUR is yet to place when new but showed ability last time in and any positive market moves must be respected. Former Victorian mare COSMIC DYNASTY found a couple better as fave at her local debut but will be better for that hitout.

raceTips.comment: HOOROO makes his debut and at age six, he’s obviously shown talent at home for them to persist with him. He found the line well in a recent 1000m Rockhampton trial and gate two should see him afforded every chance. QUEEN OF RUSSIA resumes for the new stable. She’s had the one start, where she raced up on speed and weakened late over 1250m at Newcastle. She should find this easier and looks ready to go off a recent Townsville trial win. WAVE DANCER kicks off for the new yard. She’s been placed in four of her eight starts and found the line well in a recent trial. She will just need luck from the wide gate. CHEERS HONEY debuts. She too worked home nicely at her latest trial and she’ll jump from the inside draw.

bestBets.overview: Local mare LUCKY LASS has been a model of consistency of late and plummets in weight for this. There's no reason to think she won't be playing a role in the finish again. THE EXTREME CAT was specked at juicy odds when running an improved race on Saturday and must've pulled up well to be backing up here. CONTEMPORARY wasn't far away in the Cairns Newmarket last week and will appreciate the drop in grade. REGAL JUDGEMENT has performed well at both runs back from a break but faces a rise in class.

raceTips.comment: CONTEMPORARY just looked to peak on his run late last start in the Cairns Newmarket. Fitter, he drops back in grade and the slight drop back in trip will suit. THE EXTREME CAT hit the line strongly last start at Cairns to claim third. He’ll appreciate getting out onto a bigger track and from the wide gate, he’ll get back and be doing his best work late. LUCKY LASS is hard fit and racing well. She loves it here at her home track and whilst she does rise in grade, she gets in with just 53.5kgs on her back. OUTWITTED got the job done last start over 1200m at Rockhampton. He strips fitter and the extra 100m will suit.

bestBets.overview: Former Tony Gollan representative ADRANOS found little after facing the breeze at Ipswich but he's typically honest and should get every chance to bounce back from the inside marble. His stablemate LONHY'S FABRE gave a big sight in the Northern Jewel before the break and has tuned up for this with a trial placing. EMILIA JANE tired from on pace when rising in grade second up but this is easier and she finished off hard to prevail narrowly fresh. TARA I AM led throughout when resuming and draws to advantage.

raceTips.comment: EMILIA JANE proved too good when resuming for the new stable over 1200m here but just tired late last time when stepping out to 1400m. Freshened, she drops back in grade and in trip. ADRANOS is a recent addition to the Ricky Vale yard. He hasn’t won for a long time but is hard fit and should find this slightly easier than what he’s been contesting. TARA I AM kicked off her campaign with the strong all-the-win over 1100m at Rockhampton. She strips fitter and will take catching from the low draw. SHIPPING LANE resumes from a lengthy break. The former SE Qld trained galloper looked sharp winning a recent trial and the 1100m kick off will suit.

bestBets.overview: SETTAT has scored strong on-pace wins at his past couple and is yet to miss a place from five tries at this trip. Expect another bold showing. RED HOT LIZZIE finished off hard to take the Cairns Newmarket. She rises sharply in weight on that and is unknown at this longer trip but the strength of that performance suggests it won't be a problem. ACROPHOBIC made good ground from the back in that race and boasts a strong record this route. UPSTART LEGEND was never likely last time but had been going great guns prior.

raceTips.comment: ODEEGARD is one of several runners here on the quick back up from the Cairns Carnival. It was a solid performance to finish second in the Newmarket when dropping back from 2000m to 1400m. He looks well placed at the 1560m here and will be strong late. ACROPHOBIC also comes out of the Newmarket where he settled at the tail and made a long sustained run around the field to claim fourth. He gets the outside draw again but will relish the rise in trip. RED HOT LIZZIE comes off a big win in the Cairns Newmarket. She’s a very honest mare and is unbeaten in two runs here but she will have to lump the full 63kgs. SETTAT is looking to make it a hat-trick of wins. He boasts a great record over the mile and will be in it for a long way.

bestBets.overview: Former Victorian THE DEFENDER scored a dominant maiden win when making his local debut. He'll only be improved and this looks a suitable progression. He's a top chance for the double. SUPID DATE wasn't disgraced in the Townsville Guineas before finding a couple better as favourite last time. HEROIC TALENT will find this easier than the Rockhampton and Mackay Guineas he's contested at his past couple and can improve accordingly. SUJEED is proved when new and two of his three career wins have come at this trip.

raceTips.comment: THE DEFENDER kicked off for the new stable with a dominant 5.2 length victory over 1200m at Emerald. He strips fitter and draws to get the right run. SUPID DATE is fit and racing well. Back in trip, the blinkers go on and she’ll appreciate the coming back in grade. SUJEED resumes. He turned out some good performances last campaign in stronger company and has won first up previously. The 1200m kick off will suit. HEROIC TALENT comes off a six week freshened up. Down in grade and in trip, he can certainly figure.

bestBets.overview: HUMBLE HERO comes into this off a freshen but has been racing in career-best form and has been kept up to the mark with a home track trial placing. DALT JAZ stormed home at Townsville to make it two wins from his past three outings and Wiggins sticks. FABULEAN tired after leading fresh but will be better for the hitout and is right in this on her better form. TRIPLE TRIPLE was specked at big odds when running an improved race at Rocky and may be worth following now.

raceTips.comment: DATZ JAZ has won two of his past three starts and looks well placed to salute again. He charged home over the top of them late last start over the 1000m and the slight rise in trip will suit. FABULEAN weakened late when resuming over 1000m at Townsville but was found to have an issue within her eye post race. She will have taken improvement from the run and with even luck from the wide gate, she’ll be right in this. LA PETITE MAISON got well back and found trouble when resuming off a let up. Fitter, he draws well and can improve. TRIPLE TRIPLE just found one better when kicking off for the new stable at Rockhampton. He strips fitter and with the advantage of the inside draw, he’ll be in it for a long way.
